Commands.phobos_shipbreaker_commands_pho:
Phobos Shipbreaker commands:
phobosshipbreaker help - show commands
phobosshipbreaker status [fixture-ID] - show fixtures, IDs and processing state
phobosshipbreaker settings - show active settings and the config filename
phobosshipbreaker dependencies - show loaded versions, template checks and recipe registration
phobosshipbreaker start [fixture-ID] - start or resume processing
phobosshipbreaker pause [fixture-ID] - pause, keeping progress
phobosshipbreaker cancel [fixture-ID] - clear queued work; keep panels, no energy refund
phobosshipbreaker feed [fixture-ID] - open the manual feed fallback
phobosshipbreaker products [fixture-ID] - open the product tray
Omit the ID only when there is one fixture on the selected crew member's ship. Stand beside it for controls.
Residue collector controls: phoboscollector help
Test-save setup uses native commands: spawn PhobosShipbreakerLoose / spawn ItmWall1x1Loose. Install normally.

Furnace.name: Electric Furnace
Furnace.description: Turn scrap into castings. 6 x 6 electric batch furnace; 240 kg empty, rated for 50 kg. Choose the next charge: twenty separate 1 kg aluminium scraps become a rough machinery housing or four aluminium ingots; twenty steel scraps become four steel ingots in a hotter, longer cycle. Heats at up to 250 kW. Connect one exterior radiator or underside thermal port. Hot metal and gas stay sealed until cooled. Use Control Panel or F3: phobosfurnace help.
Furnace.radiator_description: 6 x 4 fixed exterior radiator; 100 kg. Six mounting points require intact hull walls. Place outside, facing the same direction as the F6, with centres six tiles apart. Retains heat when disconnected; no free cooling in a room.
Furnace.feed_description: Accepts twenty separate, empty, unstacked 1 kg scraps of the metal the selected recipe takes: aluminium, or steel for steel ingots. The sealed chamber locks its physical feed until safe release.
Furnace.blank_description: A rough 19 kg aluminium casting, ready for finishing. An assembly table turns it into an 18 kg housing and 1 kg aluminium offcut.
Furnace.housing_description: 18 kg non-pressure housing for optional D4 and R4 section recipes. Does not replace precision mechanisms, electronics or existing construction routes.
Furnace.remainder_description: The last 1 kg from a melt. No supported recipe recovers it as aluminium or reclaimer feed. Keep it separate from useful scrap.
Furnace.section_description: 80 kg unpowered assembly section. Choose Install to build the 240 kg F6 furnace from three matching sections at its final location. Assembly information explains the tools and hauling.
Furnace.protected: Saved furnace contents or progress could not be checked safely. Original records and cargo are kept. Heating and maintenance are blocked; inspect the log before recovery.
Furnace.reloaded: Heating paused after loading. Heat and gas are kept; choose Resume. Time outside the running game does not cool the furnace.
Furnace.interval: More than 60 seconds passed between updates. Heating paused; stored heat is kept.
Furnace.charge_changed: Captured charge or ship identity changed. Heating paused; stored heat is retained. Restore the exact charge before continuing.
Furnace.power_lost: Electrical supply lost. Heating paused; passive cooling continues where physically connected.
Furnace.fault_player: Furnace paused after a fault. Check the log before resuming.
Furnace.flight: Flight demand has priority. Furnace heating paused; resume explicitly after manoeuvring.
Furnace.stopped: Heat isolated. Charge, receiver gas and stored heat remain. Passive cooling continues.
Furnace.install: Install and repair the equipment before this operation.
Furnace.geometry: Cooling connection unavailable. Face both devices the same way on the same ship. Exterior radiator: six tiles behind the F6 across six intact hull walls, with fins outside. Thermal port: one designated left or right side connection, supported by an intact sealed floor.
Furnace.hot_maintenance: Before changing cooling equipment, cool both units to 50 C or below, stop and empty the furnace, and resolve any saved-state fault. Empty its feed and product inventories first.
Furnace.sealed: Chamber sealed; charge and gas retained. Resume to evacuate and heat.
Furnace.range: Enter a finite value from {0} to {1}, using a decimal point.
Furnace.resume_block: Resume requires the exact captive charge, working probes, installed equipment and a paired cooling assembly. Stop flight demand first; cold/equalized batches require their next local operation.
Furnace.enabled: Processing enabled. Heating follows the power actually supplied. Choose Resume after an interruption.
Furnace.seal_block: Load exactly twenty separate 1 kg aluminium scraps. Cool the lining below 50 C, connect one cooling assembly, power the instruments and supply an accepting room at 250-323.15 K. The chamber gas must fit in its finite receiver.
Furnace.equalize_block: Cool below 50 C before returning gas. Working probes, unchanged charge and accepting room thermal capacity are required. If the compartment was rebuilt, operate the valve locally on the same ship.
Furnace.ready: Gas returned to the adjacent room; receiver emptied. Safe release is available.
Furnace.release_block: Release requires a cool, equalized, unchanged charge, space for every product and cooling-store capacity for the remaining sensible heat. Incomplete batches return the original charge.
Furnace.released: Charge released and receiver ready for another batch. Remaining lining and cooling-store heat are retained.
Furnace.help:
phobosfurnace list | controls <full-id> | status <full-id> | pair <furnace-id> <cooling-id> | unpair <full-id> | feed <furnace-id> | products <furnace-id> | recipe <furnace-id> <housing|aluminium-ingots|steel-ingots> | seal <furnace-id> | resume <furnace-id> | next <furnace-id> | stop <furnace-id> | equalize <furnace-id> | release <furnace-id> | automatic <furnace-id> | step-mode <furnace-id> | repeat <furnace-id> | repeat-stop <furnace-id> | heat <furnace-id> <1-250 kW> | ramp <furnace-id> <0.1-5 K/s> | cool <furnace-id> <1-100 kW>. Full IDs and normal access checks are required.
phobosfurnace cooling-direct <furnace-ID>
phobosfurnace cooling-left <furnace-ID>
phobosfurnace cooling-right <furnace-ID>
Cooling mode changes require a cool, empty furnace and cool paired assembly. Piped modes require F6-C conduits to an F6-R radiator; pair using the existing command.
phobosfurnace coolant-managed/coolant-sealed/coolant-fill/coolant-drain <furnace-ID>
Furnace.guard_legend: Guarded switch: enable/resume or isolate heat. The bottom STOP button remains available with the guard closed.
Furnace.display_overflow: Outside digit-display range; use the full reading
Furnace.connection_ship: Mount both devices on the same ship.
Furnace.connection_socket: Not at an F6 attachment socket. Use a side socket for the port or the rear exterior radiator position shown in the installation key.
Furnace.connection_rotation: Wrong rotation: rotate the cooling assembly to face the same way as the furnace. Leave the furnace in place.
Furnace.connection_unpaired: Mounting aligns. Select Pair to establish the saved cooling connection.
Furnace.installation_legend: Linked attachment: {0}. P = optional side port; R = exterior radiator. Choose ONE. The arrow marks front access; the pale bar marks the retained rear hull. The key rotates with the furnace; green marks a valid physical link, not a temperature or probe reading.
Furnace.meter_legend: Selector: ISOLATE / AUTO / STEP. Gauges: charge temperature / delivered electrical power / remaining cooling capacity. Green lamp: processing enabled.
Recipe.PhobosFinishFurnaceHousing.name: Finish aluminium machinery housing
Recipe.PhobosFinishFurnaceHousing.descri: Finish one 19 kg casting into an 18 kg housing and one 1 kg aluminium offcut.
Recipe.PhobosBuildShipbreakerSectionCast: Optional cast-housing route: one 18 kg housing supplements steel, aluminium, mechanisms and electronics. The existing recipe remains available.
Recipe.PhobosBuildReclaimerSectionCast.d: Optional cast-housing route: one 18 kg housing and native parts produce a 90 kg R4 section. The existing recipe remains available.
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnaceSection.name: Furnace Assembly Section
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnaceSection.descrip: Build one 80 kg F6 section. Three sections make the full 240 kg furnace.
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnace.name: Electric Furnace
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnace.description: Join three 80 kg F6 sections into a 240 kg, 6 x 6 electric furnace. Requires one paired cooling assembly: exterior radiator or underside thermal port.
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnaceRadiator.name: Exterior Radiator
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnaceRadiator.descri: Build the 100 kg, 6 x 4 exterior F6 radiator. Mount outside on six intact hull walls.
Furnace.owned_ship: Pair cooling equipment on a player-owned ship.
Furnace.cooling_status: Cooling store: {0:F1} C; remaining capacity to 250 C: {1:F2} MJ
Furnace.locked: Unlock the equipment first. If product release was interrupted, inspect the fault before recovery.
Furnace.port_description: Sealed 1 x 1 deck fitting and complete 100 kg underside radiator assembly. Mount on an intact sealed floor beside either F6 side connection, facing the same direction. Keep the structural floor: it remains the pressure barrier. The 12 m2 underside radiator is represented by this assembly, not a simulated lower deck. Pair one cooling assembly per furnace.
Furnace.port_support: Mounting fault: restore an intact installed sealed floor beneath the port; a wall, damaged or EVA floor is not a usable support.
Furnace.radiator_mount_fault: Mounting fault: restore six rear hull supports and clear floor/wall tiles from the exterior fin footprint.
Furnace.underside_ready: Sealed underside cooling assembly supported. Structural floor retained.
Recipe.PhobosBuildFurnaceThermalPort.des: Build a complete 100 kg underside radiator assembly with a sealed 1 x 1 deck fitting. Mount beside the F6 on an intact sealed floor; the floor remains the pressure barrier.
Cut one unused 19 kg housing blank into 19 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the casting. Cold released castings only, never melt remainder or historic residue.
Recipe.PhobosRecoverFurnaceHousing.name: Recover aluminium from finished housing
Recipe.PhobosRecoverFurnaceHousing.descr: Cut one unused 18 kg finished housing into 18 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the casting. Cold released castings only, never melt remainder or historic residue.
Furnace.coolant_pipe: Phobos' Rivetline F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit
Furnace.coolant_pipe_desc: A 1 kg insulated twin-channel service conduit. Supply and return share one jacket. Connect an F6 side fitting to the interior service point behind an F6-R radiator mounting wall. Separate from irrigation and drinking water. Maximum route: {0} conduit tiles; one furnace and one radiator per circuit. With serviced coolant the pump fills it, about 0.33 kg a tile, and it keeps its coolant: drain it into a canister before taking it up. The sealed assembly keeps it empty.
Furnace.coolant_waste: Phobos' Rivetline Retained Coolant Conduit Waste
Furnace.coolant_connected: Sealed coolant circuit connected. Supply and return share one jacket; circulation requires electricity.
Furnace.coolant_fault: Coolant route unavailable. Use an exterior F6-R radiator, intact F6-C pipes on structural floor, at most {0} route tiles, and one furnace/radiator per circuit. Check rotations, supporting floor and both service points. Heat remains stored.
Phobos' Rivetline F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit
Build a 1 kg twin-channel conduit jacket and sealed couplings from one aluminium scrap. Supply and return share the route; no loose water is produced.
Furnace.coolant_controls: Cooling connection mode (change only when cool and empty). Piped modes use F6-C conduits and the F6-R interior service point; the diagram above shows direct mounting positions.
Furnace.charge_status: Coolant: {0}; clean {1:0.000} kg; caught leakage {2:0.000} kg. Calculated pressure {3:0.0} kPa; priming {4:0.0} s. Stored heat is kept.
Furnace.charge_service: Service locally while cool, idle and paused, with a cool paired assembly. Select piped cooling, enable serviced coolant, place 1 kg charges in Products, and fill up to 6 kg. The pump sends anything above 5 kg into the conduit until it is full, about 0.33 kg a tile, so keep loading charges until the circuit reads full. Drain into retained waste before disabling service or removing equipment; drain the conduit itself with a drain canister.
Furnace.coolant_drain: Drain coolant and catch tank (local, cool)
Furnace.charge_item: Phobos' Rivetline Thermal Service Fluid Charge
Furnace.charge_waste: Phobos' Rivetline Retained Thermal Service Fluid
Furnace.charge_desc: Fictional industrial coolant, separate from water and agriculture feed. 1 kg fresh charge; recorded waste quantity varies. Fill only a cool serviced F6 circuit. Broken routes leak into sealed secondary containment; retained fluid and thermal energy never vanish. No potable use or regeneration.
Routing.charge_full: Charge bin full ({0} pieces). Receiving paused; seal and start the furnace explicitly.
Routing.no_belt: These do not touch and no conveyor belt joins them. Lay Rivetline conveyor belt (INSTALL > MISC) from one to the other, or place them within one tile.
Routing.belt_changed: The conveyor belt between them was cut, damaged or taken up, or one of them moved. Mend or relay the belt, then resume.
Routing.resumed: Resumed after the reload; the belt route was running when the game was saved.
Routing.furnace_cold: Material transfer requires an idle, cool, unsealed furnace with no protected or unfinished inventory operation.
Routing.furnace_bin: Restore and unlock the furnace charge bin; remove unsupported or stacked feed.
Routing.furnace_interlock: Receiving paused. Restore the cooling connection, cooling capacity, instrumentation and power; flight takes priority. Press Receive to resume.
Routing.installation_legend: Amber front-corner markers: input on the furnace’s left, output on its right. They rotate with the furnace. Material reaches them by conveyor belt, or from equipment within one tile, independently of cooling pipes and electrical conduit.
Capture.intake: One intact, aligned G4/chute/D4 intake is required.
Capture.target: Select a free-space, unoccupied ship. Stations, hidden contacts and AI-controlled ships are not capture targets.
Capture.ownership: This capture stage requires a player-owned target with no people aboard.
Capture.unbound: No capture target set. Select a target in navigation, then choose a navigation console below.
Capture.resume_required: Suspended after reload — explicit Start / Resume required.
Capture.scope: Capture alone does not authorize cutting or processing. Start reclamation explicitly for supported ordinary walls, after safe preparation.
Capture.changed: Capture equipment changed or lost power. Restore the original equipment, or release the mooring and select the setup again.
Capture.attached: Release existing docking/mooring before approaching a new working window.
Capture.stopped: Capture approach stopped. Existing velocity and any mooring remain; this is not a braking command.
Capture.stop_rebind: Stop the approach and release the recorded attachment before rebinding.
Capture.select: Select a target on navigation and choose an installed N1/N2 navigation console on this ship.
Capture.save: Capture state could not be recorded. Automation is suspended; inspect the retained attachment.
Capture.bound: G4, intake, navigation equipment and target selected. Start / Resume begins approach and capture.
Capture.uncertain: Capture or release could not be confirmed. It will not retry automatically. Release applies only to the recorded mooring.
Capture.fit: No collision-compatible native mooring pose reaches an ordinary wall at this G4 mouth. Reposition or use another explicitly selected G4.
Capture.contact: Native mooring established. Automatic cutting additionally requires a separately retained anchor wall/floor and explicit reclamation authorization.
Capture.no_contact: Moored, but the post-capture G4 contact check failed. Cargo is unchanged. Release and reassess.
Capture.released: Recorded mooring released. Cargo remains on its original ship. Reassess before the next approach; release does not brake.
Capture.controls: Temporary G4 capture. Select the target in navigation before binding.
Capture.dependency: Phobos Auto Nav {0}+ is required by Shipbreaker.
Capture.reconciled: No recorded mooring or anchors remain. Binding retained; press Start again for a fresh approach.
Reclamation.help: Bind this G4, its H4/D4 and an N1/N2 console to an owned, unoccupied target. Start enables powered ordinary-wall cutting and this D4 intake. Use explicit Release to detach a capture.
Reclamation.work: Work completed: {0:F1}/{1:F1} powered seconds at {2:F1} kW.
Reclamation.suspended: Suspended. Work and cargo retained; explicit Resume is required. An existing capture stays attached.
Reclamation.resume: This G4 has a saved job. Resume keeps its target and completed work.
Reclamation.intake: The bound G4/D4 intake is paused or changed. Prepare it, then explicitly Resume this mission.
Reclamation.recapture: This capture needs a separate intact anchor wall and floor, with matching recorded ports. Release and recapture before automatic cutting.
Reclamation.uncertain: Wall removal or transfer could not be confirmed. Work stopped; the object and records are kept. Inspect the fault before continuing.
Reclamation.contact: Target tracking lost. Work suspended; restore contact, then choose Resume.
Reclamation.geometry: Waiting for the target ship layout to update before cutting.
Reclamation.pressure: The target contains pressure above 0.1 kPa or an unknown room reading. Safely depressurize it manually before reclaiming walls.
Reclamation.wall_changed: The bound wall changed, moved out of jaw reach or became unsafe. Paid work is retained on its exact identity.
Reclamation.capacity: Capacity wait. Clear the G4/D4 path; this authorized mission can continue when space returns.
Reclamation.native_wait: Waiting for wall removal to finish. It will not be removed twice.
Reclamation.navigation: Navigation authority ended. Observe the target and explicitly Resume.
Reclamation.cutting: Powered cutting. Heat is rejected through the connected D4 interior service area.
Reclamation.feeding: One real wall is in the G4; the existing 2 kW intake transfers it before further cutting.
Reclamation.manual: Manual movement took control. Reclamation cannot resume automatically.
Reclamation.power: Waiting for electricity. Cutting only advances while powered.
Reclamation.phase_Exhausted: Supported walls exhausted; retained structure remains
Crew.repair: Equipment requires repair, installation or unlocked access.
Crew.select_recipe: Choose the process for this equipment.
Crew.bound_target: An explicitly permitted mission must match the G4's recorded target and equipment chain. Changed bindings require a fresh Enable / Resume.
Crew.hot_permission: Hot furnace batches require explicit permission.
Crew.supplies: Missing approved feed, required servicing or destination space.
Crew.skip_exterior: Exterior work and movement are suspended for time-skip; explicitly Resume afterwards.
Crew.action_reclaim: Prepare and resume the selected reclamation job
Crew.action_seal: Load and seal the approved furnace batch
Assembly.title: Assembly information
Assembly.instructions:
This is one unpowered assembly section. You need {0} matching sections of {1} kg each, a Mortorq tool and a soldering tool. The completed machine weighs {2} kg.

Choose Install on a section, or choose the machine in INSTALL > APPS, then place its outline where it will operate. Native construction work brings sections to the site one at a time; they use the drag slot, not your hands. Keep a clear route for crew and bulky parts. No table is needed for final assembly.

The construction site retains delivered parts and work progress across saves. Cancel its native construction order to recover delivered parts. Do not dismantle the sections to assemble the machine.

A complete loose machine still has its own Install action. Once assembled and installed, use Control Panel. Sections can still be made at a suitable work table.
Maintenance.ready: No extra machinery restriction currently blocks removal. Native access, tools and material requirements still apply.
Maintenance.protected: This machine has an unfinished or unreadable saved operation. Keep it in place and inspect its control panel; do not discard its saved contents.
Maintenance.coolant: Drain the retained coolant through the control panel before removing this equipment.
Maintenance.batch: Finish or safely release the current furnace batch before removing this equipment.
Maintenance.hot: Let the equipment cool to 50 C or below before removal. An unavailable temperature reading also blocks removal.
Maintenance.feed: Empty the furnace feed before removal.
Maintenance.products: Take the finished products out before removal.
Maintenance.trapped: Cargo remains inside this cooling unit. Stand beside it and choose Recover stored cargo, then move the items out.
Maintenance.repair_hot: Repair is held while the equipment is hot, pressurised or delivering a batch. Let it cool and safely finish or release the batch through its controls.
Maintenance.recovery_help: Move the stored items out of this cooling unit using the inventory window. New deposits are blocked; this is recovery access for older saves.
Maintenance.no_cargo: No stored cargo is available here.
Maintenance.reserved: Cargo is reserved for an active operation. Finish or cancel that native work before recovering it.
Furnace.repeat_started: Repeat run on. The furnace seals, runs, equalizes and releases each full charge until you end the run.
Furnace.repeat_ended: Repeat run ended. The current batch, charge and stored heat are unchanged; finish it with the normal controls.
Furnace.repeat_paused: Repeat run paused: {0} Choose Repeat batches to continue.
Furnace.repeat_protected: The saved repeat-run record cannot be read safely and is kept unchanged. Choose End repeat run to clear it; the furnace, charge and heat are not affected.
Furnace.repeat_block: Repeat needs an installed furnace on your own ship, a room at the furnace and a working, paired cooling assembly.
Furnace.repeat_changed: The furnace's ship, room or cooling assembly changed after the run started.
Furnace.repeat_interrupted: Heating stopped before the batch finished.
Furnace.repeat_equalized: Chamber gas returned to the room.
Furnace.repeat_released: Batch released. Batches released this run: {0}.
Furnace.repeat_returned: Unfinished charge returned unchanged. The run will seal it again.
Furnace.repeat_waiting: Waiting for a full charge: {0} of {1} aluminium pieces.
Furnace.repeat_reloaded: Paused after loading. Choose Repeat batches to continue.
Crew.repeat_run: The furnace's repeat run is handling sealing, heating and release. Crew still bring aluminium and clear products.
Storage.paused: Unloading paused. Choose a store on the Routing page, then start unloading.
Storage.paused_manual: Unloading paused; products stay in the tray.
Storage.full: Store full, or it will not take this item. Products wait in the tray; unloading continues once there is space.
Storage.moving: Moving one item to storage: {0} of {1} s.
Storage.blocked: Transfer blocked; the item stays in the tray.
Storage.fault: Unloading fault. Paused with products kept in the tray; check the log before starting again.
Storage.none: No store chosen. Pick one on the Routing page first.
Storage.protected: The saved store choice cannot be read safely and is kept unchanged. Unlink storage to clear it; products are not affected.
Storage.missing: The chosen store is gone. Pick another store.
Storage.ineligible: Choose an unlocked storage container with a limited capacity on the same ship. People, machine trays and Phobos equipment cannot be stores.
Storage.no_route: This machine and the store do not touch and no conveyor belt joins them. Lay belt from one to the other, or choose a store within one tile.
Storage.route_changed: The store, the machine or the belt between them changed. Unloading paused; check them and start again.
Storage.linked: Store chosen: {0}. Start unloading to move products.
Storage.unlinked: Store choice cleared. Products stay where they are.
Storage.unsupported: Only the D4 dismantling fixture and R4 reclaimer unload to storage.
Storage.owned_ship: Storage unloading works only on your own ship.
Storage.no_candidates: No suitable store on this ship. Place an unlocked storage container within one tile of the machine, or at the end of a conveyor belt from it.
Reclaimer.cooling_wait: Waiting for the room to cool: {0:F1} °C now, limit {1:F0} °C; {2:F0} mol of air at {3:F0} kPa (needs {4} kPa). No power is drawn and work continues by itself once the room can take the heat.
ProcessingService.queue_waiting_for_wall: Queue armed; waiting for structural parts in the feed (ordinary walls, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows). They can come from a crew loading order, the feed window in the controls or a connected grabber.
ProcessRecipes.unsupported_wall_mass: No panel recipe for a {0} kg wall. Ordinary walls weigh {1} to {2} kg.
Industry.feed_order_action: [us] [switches] crew loading of [them] on or off.
Industry.feed_order_tooltip: Crew keep this feed loaded with what is aboard until you switch it off. Carries on through time-skips and reloads. Furnace heating still needs the hazardous permission.
Crew.loading_on: Crew loading on for {0}. Crew with AutoTask and the Haul duty bring supplies from anywhere aboard until you switch it off.
Crew.loading_off: Crew loading off for {0}. Cargo and work stay where they are.
Crew.loading_not_owned: Crew loading needs equipment on your own ship.
Crew.loading_unsupported: Crew loading is not available for this equipment.
ProcessRecipes.unsupported_family_mass: No {0} recipe for a {1} kg part; this family is taken from {2} to {3} kg.
ProcessingService.no_recipe_for_family_m: {0} weighs {1:F2} kg; {2} are taken from {3} to {4} kg in {5}.
Feed.reject_floor_name: Phobos' Floor Grate Rejects R1 (1 kg)
Feed.reject_floor_description: What the fixture could not separate from a floor grate: coatings, fasteners and grate fines, one kilogram a unit. Nothing more comes out of it. Store, haul or sell where accepted; it stacks to ten.
Feed.reject_durawal_description: The laminated cladding of a DuraWal interior wall, bonded to its filler. The fixture takes the plastic skin, fittings and frame; this is the rest. No further recipe.
Feed.reject_window_description: Glazing and seals from a window panel. The game has no glass to recover, so this stays waste. No further recipe.
Feed.reject_whipple_description: Spacer mesh and bonding from a Whipple shielding panel after its aluminium is taken. No further recipe.
Feed.reject_aero_name: Phobos' Aero Panel Rejects R1 (2.1 kg)
Feed.reject_aero_description: Composite core and adhesive from an aerodynamic panel after its skin and aluminium are taken. No further recipe.
Thaw.name: Ice Thaw Unit
Thaw.description: An enclosed 2 x 2 thaw unit, {0:F0} kg. Melts one {1:G} kg block of water ice at a time into {2:G} kg of process water for a linked water silo, touching it or on its water line, and drops {3:G} kg of gangue into its tray, drawing {4:G} kW for {5:G} minutes a block. It also breaks down a {6:G} kg block of methane ice in {9:G} minutes: {7:G} kg of water to the silo and {8:G} kg of methane to a linked methane store (Phobos Manufacturing), never into the air. Part of the power warms the room, so keep some air around it. Not a drinking-water source.
Thaw.feed_description: Holds {0} blocks: water ice ({1:G} kg) or methane ice ({2:G} kg). Gangue and stacked blocks are refused; place one block at a time. Methane ice waits until a methane store is linked.
Thaw.paused: Paused. Load water ice or methane ice, link a vessel and start.
Thaw.feed_empty: Feed empty. Waiting for water ice.
Thaw.invalid_feed: Only single, empty blocks of water ice ({0:G} kg) or methane ice ({1:G} kg).
Thaw.vessel_not_ready: the linked vessel is damaged, locked, moved away or not on this ship
Thaw.vessel_protected: the linked vessel is protected or busy; accept its contents or wait
Thaw.vessel_catch: the linked vessel holds trapped water; recover it after repair
Thaw.vessel_full: the linked vessel has {0:F1} kg of room and a block needs {1:G} kg
Thaw.tray_full: Waiting: the gangue tray is full. Empty it.
Thaw.input_changed: The ice block changed or was removed. Queue paused.
Thaw.output_definition_changed: The game's ice gangue definition changed; the block was not finished.
Thaw.output_placement_failed: The gangue could not be placed in the tray.
Thaw.input_not_removed: The ice block could not be removed from the feed.
Thaw.complete: Block finished. Start again for the next one.
Thaw.fault: Thaw fault. Queue paused; check the log.
Thaw.cancelled: Work cancelled. The ice stays in the feed; spent energy is lost.
Thaw.completed_log: Thawed block {0}: {1:G} kg of water into {2}, {3:G} kg of gangue to the tray.
Thaw.linked: Linked. Water from each block goes to this vessel.
Thaw.link_missing: Choose an installed water silo touching the thaw unit or on its water line, on this ship.
Thaw.link_busy: Pause the thaw unit before changing where it delivers.
Thaw.install_first: Install the undamaged thaw unit first.
Thaw.unlock: Unlock the thaw unit, its feed and its tray.
Thaw.switched_off: The thaw unit is switched off.
Thaw.missing_feed: The thaw unit is missing its feed or tray.
Thaw.demand: Working power: {0:G} kW, about {1:G} kW of it warming the room.
Crew.recipe_thaw: Thaw water ice into the linked vessel
Furnace.recipe_set: Next charge: {0}. The chamber now takes {1}.
Furnace.recipe_block: Choose the recipe while the furnace is idle and cool, with an empty charge chamber and no repeat run.
Furnace.recipe_unknown: Unknown recipe. Choose housing, aluminium-ingots or steel-ingots.
Furnace.aluminium_ingot_description: A 4 kg cast aluminium ingot from an F6 ingot charge: clean stock for machining and coming Manufacturing work. Every twenty scraps give four ingots, three scrap gates and one remainder. A table can cut it back into four aluminium scraps; that loses value.
Furnace.steel_ingot_description: A 4 kg cast steel ingot from an F6 steel charge, the hotter and longer cycle. Clean stock for machining and coming Manufacturing work. A table can cut it back into four steel scraps; that loses value.
Furnace.steel_remainder_description: The last 1 kg from a steel melt: slag and skull. No recipe recovers it. Keep it apart from useful scrap.
Recipe.PhobosRecoverAluminiumIngot.name: Recover aluminium from ingot
Recipe.PhobosRecoverAluminiumIngot.descr: Cut one 4 kg aluminium ingot into 4 kg of identified aluminium scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the ingot and loses its value.
Recipe.PhobosRecoverSteelIngot.name: Recover steel from ingot
Recipe.PhobosRecoverSteelIngot.descripti: Cut one 4 kg steel ingot into 4 kg of identified steel scrap. All cuttings are retained; this destroys the ingot and loses its value.
Bin.name: Material Bin
Bin.description: A sealed {2} x {2} bin in a {0:F0} kg housing, with a {1} x {1} storage grid for mined material only: ore, loose regolith, gangue, water and methane ice, and mined chunks. Ore stacks six to a cell. Crew can fetch from it and put products into it like any unlocked container, and the lid keeps loose rock from drifting off.
Bin.missing_native_trigger: Material bins not registered: the game's {0} container rule is missing.
EquipmentEconomy.empty_the_bin_before_di: Empty the bin before dismantling. Repair replaces failed parts; Restore treats wear using tools.
Settings.spawn_ice_fields: Let the game's own ice asteroids appear in C- and S-class asteroid fields, about one asteroid in twenty. Only asteroids generated for a new game are affected; asteroids already in a save stay as they were.
Settings.extra_deposit_ice: Let C-class ore deposits give water ice a little more often, in place of some silicates. Affects future mining in existing saves too.
Ice.missing_cluster: Ice asteroid fields not added: the game's {0} cluster blueprint is missing.
Ice.missing_table: Ice supply not added to loot table {0}: the table is missing.
Thaw.no_methane_store: methane ice needs a linked methane store
